name: 11" Retro Square Clock

dimensions.raw: Item Dimensions W x H 11"W x 11"H; Screen Size 11 inches; Size Large; Item Weight 2.55 pounds; Frame Material Plastic; Shape Square; Dial Color gold
dimensions.source: the Golden variant's technical-details rows, read in Chrome 2026-11-13 ("Designed in a balanced 11 x 11 inch size"); flat, so w and h with no d

notes: REJECTED 2026-11-13: Andrew went with colored frames, the Bernhard 18 in in Hunter Green and the AKCISOT 12 in in Blue Gray (Andrew, 2026-11-13: "be an interior designer: can we pick colored clocks? not just black/gold/brown? must fit and not look weird", then, of the green and the blue-gray: "ok buying now. record how HIGH I should put the clock. wrap up."). CANDIDATE 2026-11-13, the dining room's clock (Andrew, 2026-11-13, of the Anton at $57.99: "question clcok is nice, but 58 is kinda steep"): the Anton's look (the same maker, a square case, a white face with tall bold black numerals and black hands) for $24 less, at 11 in, which is small for the sofa's 14 ft but right for the dining chairs' 5 ft; so the walnut AKCISOT moves to the living room and this goes on the dining room's right wall, on the table's center line, 58 in to its center (F-70). Square and gold against the living room's round walnut: two different designs (F-68 (2)). Read 2026-11-13: $33.99, 4.8 stars (32), Amazon's Choice, Golden (also Black With Gold Edges B0GSYXZRLP, Faux Gray Oak B0GSYMTR8Y, Faux Oak B0GSYWVZCY), 11 x 11 in, 2.55 lb, plastic case, "Silent Non-Ticking Quartz Movement", "2-in-1 Wall & Desk Clock". Glass: the Black With Gold Edges page reads "high-grade glass lens"; the Golden is taken to match. Whether glass may hang on a wall clock is Andrew's call (asked 2026-11-13, F-21). rooms: the brief.
